title: Radio Play
idiom: mid-century gouache illustration, theatre of the mind
hero_prompt: Mid-century gouache and ink illustration on paper, flat and graphic with visible brush texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: in a dark room, an old cathedral-shaped radio drawn as a plain dark silhouette with only its round cloth speaker glowing warm amber, and rising from that glow like smoke a whole imagined scene painted in pale blue and gold, a ship on a stormy sea, a lighthouse beam, a crescent moon, the story existing only in the air above the radio. Deep midnight blue, warm amber, pale gold.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm amber ground, no shading, no gradients, no highlights: an old radio-studio ribbon microphone on a short stand, a rounded capsule shape with a few thick horizontal slots, and three bold curved sound waves spreading out to its right side. Bold, high-contrast, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
